A.name: Workout A — Squat focus (Mon)
A.description: Monday. Two clear days before your next running effort — the best day to lift heaviest. Achilles protocol: finish every session with standing calf raises and slow eccentric heel drops; control the lowering phase. Any morning Achilles stiffness or pain on a run is a stop sign for that exercise.

B.name: Workout B — Hinge focus (Wed)
B.description: Wednesday. Sits between two easy run days — moderate-heavy is fine here. Achilles protocol: finish every session with standing calf raises and slow eccentric heel drops; control the lowering phase. Any morning Achilles stiffness or pain on a run is a stop sign for that exercise.

C.name: Workout C — Light / stability (Sat)
C.description: Saturday. Day before the long run — kept deliberately light; pairs naturally with a longer yoga session. Achilles protocol: finish every session with standing calf raises and slow eccentric heel drops; control the lowering phase. Any morning Achilles stiffness or pain on a run is a stop sign for that exercise.
